query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('source_pages', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.source_pages WHERE source_page BETWEEN 734 AND 738), 'topics', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.topics WHERE slug IN ('international-finance-boundary-734','international-monetary-system-boundary-735','un-specialized-agencies-boundary-736','technical-agencies-boundary-737','development-programmes-boundary-738')), 'facts', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_facts WHERE source_page BETWEEN 734 AND 738), 'notes', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_notes WHERE source_page BETWEEN 734 AND 738), 'mcqs', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_mcqs WHERE source_page BETWEEN 734 AND 738), 'verifications', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.fact_verifications WHERE source_page BETWEEN 734 AND 738), 'flashcards', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.flashcards WHERE source_key LIKE 'batch0734-0738:%'), 'search_documents', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.search_documents d WHERE (d.entity_type='fact' AND d.entity_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.gk_facts WHERE source_page BETWEEN 734 AND 738)) OR (d.entity_type='note' AND d.entity_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.gk_notes WHERE source_page BETWEEN 734 AND 738)) OR (d.entity_type='mcq' AND d.entity_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.gk_mcqs WHERE source_page BETWEEN 734 AND 738)))) AS batch_integrity LIMIT 1;
